name: Sudan
value: Famine risk spreads to South Darfur
summary: FEWS NET says Famine risk has spread to parts of South Darfur; the army broke the RSF siege of El Obeid in Kordofan
state: FEWS NET's September 2026 to January 2027 update says the risk of Famine has spread to parts of South Darfur, including East Jebel Marra, where acute malnutrition in two of four camps assessed exceeded the Famine threshold, and persists in North Darfur and around Kadugli and Dilling (FEWS NET). In Kordofan, which the UN calls the war's epicentre, the army broke the RSF siege of El Obeid and took al-Khuwai in West Kordofan, while most aid operations there have halted (Al Jazeera, 14 Nov). Famine risk spreading to new areas keeps the Alert.
for_you: Anyone with links to Sudan should follow FCDO travel advice. Humanitarian updates come from UN OCHA; those most exposed are displaced people in Darfur and Kordofan.
rubric_hit: Alert: famine spreading to new areas (FEWS NET: Famine risk extends to parts of South Darfur)
